**Tier 6.** Its `application`, `domain` and
`infrastructure` may import only a strictly lower tier. `http/` composes freely
but may never reach into another module's `http/` or `infrastructure/`.

May import: `account`, `activity`, `catalog`, `commerce`, `customers`, `delivery`, `identity`, `invoicing`, `messaging`, `payments`, `plugins`, `settings`, `shipping`, `vintedReviews`, `vouchers`.

Currently imports: `activity`, `catalog`, `commerce`, `gift`, `identity`, `messaging`, `plugins`, `vouchers`.

Feature map entry: `loyalty` in [docs/features.json](../../../docs/features.json). Run `npm run feature -- loyalty` for its full span.
